title: uPVC Window Price in Nepal (Kathmandu Guide)
description: What affects uPVC window price in Nepal — size, glass, colour, and installation. How Hi-Tech uPVC quotes made-to-measure windows in Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur, and Pokhara.
headline: uPVC window price in Nepal — what you actually pay for.
summary: There is no single sticker price for made-to-measure uPVC. Size, glass, colour, hardware, and installation all change the quote. Here is how Hi-Tech prices work in Kathmandu and across Nepal.

sections.heading: Why uPVC windows are quoted, not listed with one price
sections.body: Every opening is different. A small bathroom casement and a full living-room sliding system use different profiles, glass area, and labour. Hi-Tech uPVC fabricates at our Tarakeshwar factory after site measurement — so the honest answer is always a made-to-measure quote, not a catalogue sticker.

sections.heading: What drives the cost
sections.body: Frame size and opening type (sliding, casement, tilt & turn) set the profile length. Glass choice — single, double, or laminated — changes comfort and price. Colour foils (anthracite, golden oak) cost more than white. Multi-point locks and quality rollers add durability. Installation access in Kathmandu apartments can also affect labour time.

sections.heading: How to get an accurate Kathmandu quote
sections.body: Use our quote builder to list openings, sizes, and finishes, then send it on WhatsApp — or book a free site measurement. We serve Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur, Pokhara, and projects across Nepal from the same Tarakeshwar factory standard.

faqs.question: What is the average uPVC window price in Nepal?
faqs.answer: It varies by size and glass. Small fixed or casement units cost less than large sliding systems with double glazing. Ask Hi-Tech for an itemised quote after measurement — that is the only accurate number.

faqs.question: Is installation included in the uPVC window price?
faqs.answer: Our quotes list fabrication and installation clearly. Free site measurement is available across the Kathmandu valley; travel for Pokhara and other cities is arranged after the quote.

faqs.question: Do coloured uPVC frames cost more than white?
faqs.answer: Yes. White is the base finish. Woodgrain and anthracite foils add material cost but avoid painting and give a finished look for decades.

title: uPVC vs Aluminium Windows in Kathmandu
description: Compare uPVC and aluminium windows for Kathmandu homes — heat, dust, noise, monsoon, and maintenance. When Hi-Tech recommends uPVC over aluminium.
headline: uPVC vs aluminium windows for Kathmandu homes.
summary: Aluminium looks slim. uPVC usually wins on insulation, noise, and condensation for valley living. Here is a practical comparison for Kathmandu, Lalitpur, and Bhaktapur.

sections.heading: Thermal comfort and condensation
sections.body: Aluminium conducts heat and cold. In Kathmandu winters, aluminium frames can feel cold and attract condensation. Multi-chamber uPVC profiles insulate better, so rooms stay warmer and glass edges stay drier — useful for bedrooms facing foggy mornings.

sections.heading: Dust, monsoon, and sealing
sections.body: Valley dust and monsoon rain punish poor seals. Quality uPVC systems with multi-point locking close tightly around the sash. Slim aluminium can look elegant, but without thermal breaks and good gaskets it often leaks air and fine dust into living rooms.

sections.heading: When aluminium still makes sense
sections.body: Very large commercial curtain walls and some ultra-minimal look projects still use aluminium. For most homes and apartments in Kathmandu and Pokhara, Hi-Tech uPVC gives better day-to-day comfort at a competitive lifecycle cost — no painting, strong seals, and long warranty on profiles and hardware.

faqs.question: Is uPVC better than aluminium for Kathmandu?
faqs.answer: For most homes, yes — especially for insulation, noise reduction, and lower maintenance. Aluminium suits some commercial facades; residential comfort usually favours uPVC.

faqs.question: Does uPVC look bulky compared with aluminium?
faqs.answer: Modern multi-chamber uPVC profiles are much slimmer than older systems. Sliding and tilt & turn designs keep sightlines clean while holding double glazing securely.

title: uPVC vs Wood Windows & Doors in Nepal
description: Why many Kathmandu homeowners switch from timber to uPVC — termites, monsoon rot, painting cycles, and sealing. How Hi-Tech woodgrain foils keep a timber look without the upkeep.
headline: uPVC vs wood: less painting, no termites, same warm look.
summary: Timber windows in Nepal fight termites, moisture, and annual varnish. uPVC with woodgrain foil keeps the look without the repair cycle — made by Hi-Tech in Tarakeshwar.

sections.heading: Termites, rot, and monsoon
sections.body: Wooden frames swell in monsoon humidity and crack in dry season sun. Termites attack untreated timber across the Kathmandu valley. uPVC is immune to rot and termites — a major reason renovations replace old teak and sal frames.

sections.heading: Maintenance cost over 10 years
sections.body: Wood needs polishing or painting every few years. Labour and scaffolding on multi-storey Kathmandu houses add up. Factory-finished uPVC needs washing with mild soap — no varnish schedule.

sections.heading: Keeping a timber aesthetic
sections.body: Hi-Tech offers woodgrain foils such as golden oak on windows, doors, and wall panels. You get the warm look of timber with sealed multi-chamber performance for dust and noise.

faqs.question: Can uPVC look like wood?
faqs.answer: Yes. Laminated woodgrain finishes mimic oak and other timbers while staying UV-stable and maintenance-free.

faqs.question: Are wooden windows bad for Nepal?
faqs.answer: Wood can be beautiful when maintained, but many valley homes struggle with termites, warping, and paint cycles. uPVC is the lower-upkeep alternative for the same openings.

title: Best Windows for Kathmandu Climate (Dust, Rain & Noise)
description: Choose windows for Kathmandu’s dust, monsoon rain, winter cold, and traffic noise. Why sealed uPVC with double glazing works for valley apartments and houses.
headline: Best windows for Kathmandu’s dust, monsoon, and noise.
summary: Kathmandu asks windows to block fine dust, heavy rain, winter chill, and road noise. Sealed multi-chamber uPVC with the right glass is built for that mix.

sections.heading: Dust and air leakage
sections.body: Fine valley dust enters through gaps around poorly sealed sashes. Multi-point locking uPVC compresses gaskets evenly — useful for Ring Road, Baneshwor, and Patan apartments facing traffic.

sections.heading: Monsoon rain and winter mornings
sections.body: Casement and tilt & turn windows that lock securely keep driving rain out. Double glazing reduces winter heat loss so bedrooms warm up faster on foggy mornings in Kathmandu and Bhaktapur.

sections.heading: Noise from roads and neighbours
sections.body: Double-glazed uPVC can cut traffic and courtyard noise significantly versus single glass in aluminium or timber. Pair the right opening type with laminated glass where bedrooms face busy streets.

faqs.question: Which uPVC window type is best for Kathmandu apartments?
faqs.answer: Tilt & turn and casement lock tightly for dust and rain. Sliding suits wide living-room openings where you want maximum glass and easy operation.

faqs.question: Do I need double glazing in Kathmandu?
faqs.answer: It is strongly recommended for bedrooms and living rooms — better insulation, less noise, and less condensation than single glass.

title: How Long Do uPVC Windows Last in Nepal?
description: Lifespan of uPVC windows and doors in Nepal’s climate — UV, monsoon, and hardware. What Hi-Tech’s 10-year profile and hardware warranty covers.
keywords: how long do uPVC windows last
headline: How long uPVC windows last in Nepal.
summary: Quality uPVC systems commonly last 25–30+ years with basic cleaning. UV-stable profiles and solid hardware matter more than marketing claims — especially under Kathmandu sun and monsoon.

sections.heading: Typical lifespan
sections.body: Well-made uPVC windows and doors routinely last 25–30 years or more. The frame does not rust or rot. Hardware (hinges, rollers, locks) may need adjustment or replacement sooner under heavy daily use — which is normal for any opening system.

sections.heading: Nepal climate factors
sections.body: Strong UV at altitude and monsoon humidity test cheaper foils and seals. Hi-Tech uses multi-chamber profiles and quality gaskets fabricated in Tarakeshwar so colour and seal performance hold up across Kathmandu, Pokhara, and hill projects.

sections.heading: Warranty and care
sections.body: We quote a 10-year warranty on profiles and hardware for standard residential installs. Care is simple: wash with mild soap, keep drainage slots clear, and avoid abrasive cleaners. No annual painting.

faqs.question: Do uPVC windows fade in Nepali sun?
faqs.answer: Quality UV-stable profiles and foils resist yellowing far better than cheap imports. White and woodgrain finishes from Hi-Tech are specified for outdoor exposure.

faqs.question: What warranty does Hi-Tech offer?
faqs.answer: Standard messaging is 10 years on profiles and hardware — confirm the exact cover on your quote for your project type.

title: How to Choose uPVC Doors for Nepal Homes
description: French, sliding, or folding uPVC doors for Kathmandu terraces and living rooms — space, weather sealing, and indoor-outdoor flow. Hi-Tech buying tips.
headline: How to choose uPVC doors for Nepal homes.
summary: Pick the opening style for the room, not just the photo. French doors suit classic openings; sliding saves swing space; folding opens entire walls to terraces.

sections.heading: French doors
sections.body: Side-hung pairs that open inwards or outwards. Ideal for dining rooms and balconies with traditional proportions. Strong multi-point locks keep Kathmandu dust and rain out when closed.

sections.heading: Sliding patio doors
sections.body: Panels glide on rollers — no swing space inside the room. Perfect for apartments and tight Lalitpur plots where furniture sits near the opening. Choose quality rollers for daily quiet use.

sections.heading: Folding / bi-fold doors
sections.body: Stacking leaves open a wide indoor-outdoor connection for terraces and lake-view Pokhara homes. Needs a solid head track and careful measurement — Hi-Tech fabricates each set to the opening.

faqs.question: Which uPVC door is best for small Kathmandu apartments?
faqs.answer: Sliding doors usually win — they do not need clearance to swing into the room.

faqs.question: Can uPVC doors be used as main entrance doors?
faqs.answer: Many projects use reinforced uPVC entrance systems. Talk to us about security hardware and glass options for your elevation.
